title: Library
description: Each key is a markdown file, relative to this library.json. It may belong to a category and lists the lessons that belong to it. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: Optional. The schema is applied automatically to any file named library.json.

$categories.description: Optional look of each category, keyed by the exact category name used on cards. Keeps category settings flat instead of nesting cards inside categories.

color.description: Color of the row in the Library view. A name, or any VS Code theme color id such as charts.red.

oneOf.description: A theme color id, for example charts.red or errorForeground.

card.description: A markdown card: where it sits and which lessons belong to it.

category.description: Cards with the same category are shown together under a folder with this name.

order.description: Position among the cards in the same category. Lower comes first. Cards without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

title.description: Shown next to the markdown name in the Library view.

description.description: One or two sentences about the card. Shown next to the name, after the title.

icon.description: Icon shown for this markdown in the Library view: an icon id from the active icon theme, or a codicon like $(book). Completion lists the theme's icons.

lessons.description: The files that belong to this markdown.

lesson.description: A file that belongs to the markdown, plus optional order and metadata.

order.description: Position under the markdown. Lower comes first. Lessons without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

title.description: Shown next to the file name in the Library view.

description.description: One or two sentences about what the file covers. Shown next to the file name, after the title.

tags.description: Free-form labels, for example topics or the day it was written.

date.description: The day this file was written, as YYYY-MM-DD.

category.description: How a category folder looks in the Library view.

icon.description: Icon for the category folder: an icon id from the active icon theme, or a codicon like $(folder-library). Completion lists the theme's icons.

order.description: Position among categories. Lower comes first. Categories without an order go after those with one, sorted by name.

description.description: Shown next to the category name.
